test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Rajesh marks his goods 30% above the cost price but allows a 12% discount for cash payment. If he sells the goods for ₹3,500, find his cost price (up to one place of decimal).
solution:
Given:

Discount % = 12%

Selling price = 3500

Mark-up = 30%

Formula:

SP - CP = Profit

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

Selling price = Marked price × Discount/100
